title: Custom import preset using local bone map file causes "Missing Project" and abnormal game running behavior
body:
### Tested versions v4.7.dev.mono.custom_build [9a8f82596] ### System information Godot v4.7.dev.mono (9a8f82596) - Windows 11 (build 26100) - Single-window, 2 monitors - Direct3D 12 (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1650 (NVIDIA; 32.0.15.9186) - AMD Ryzen 7 4800H with Radeon Graphics (16 threads) - 15.37 GiB memory ### Issue description **Local bone map file** is used in custom import preset for animation library, resulting in missing project and `Run Project` only open project manager instead of the game.
Details

Log: > ERROR: Cannot open file 'res://assets/mixamo_bone_map.tres'. > at: (scene\resources\resource_format_text.cpp:1431) > ERROR: Failed loading resource: res://assets/mixamo_bone_map.tres. > at: (core\io\resource_loader.cpp:317) > ERROR: ConfigFile parse error at B:/scripts/Godot/Playground/project.godot:37: Can't load resource at path: res://assets/mixamo_bone_map.tres with uid: uid://cseb0aadthci1. > at: _parse (core\io\config_file.cpp:293) project.godot ``` [importer_defaults] animation_library={ "_subresources": { "nodes": { "PATH:Skeleton3D": { "retarget/bone_map": Resource("uid://cseb0aadthci1", "res://assets/mixamo_bone_map.tres") } } }, ```

### Steps to reproduce Use local bone map file when importing animations, save as import presets, run the game or restart the project ### Minimal reproduction project (MRP) [Playground.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/26931270/Playground.zip)
